description.p: Foliate is a modern eBook reader built with Flutter and foliate-js. It features responsive layouts adapting between mobile and desktop, two-page book spreads, custom themes with Adwaita styling, fast in-book text search, text-to-speech narration, OPDS public catalog integration, and extensive keyboard shortcut navigation.
Initial release with mobile and desktop adaptive support, OPDS public catalogs, in-book search, and TTS narration.
